patch.value: Assurance primitives: measurements, invariants, and gates become declarative pm data evaluated by the SDK, so a project's quality contract is configuration instead of bespoke scripts

Every quality property this project enforces is expressed as a hand-written .mjs script that shells out to pm. 16 files match *gate*.mjs and carry 6,500 LOC; 55 scripts total carry 16,184 LOC; 20 of them drive the pm CLI as a subprocess to recompute properties over .agents/pm that the SDK already holds in memory. The gate inventory itself is derived by regex over human-written GitHub workflow step names, so a gate's identity is its title in prose and renaming a step silently changes the inventory. None of this is available to any other project: a team adopting pm inherits the item model and inherits none of the assurance model, and an agent cannot add, retune, or scope a bound without writing Node. Declaring a measurable property over the record, comparing it to a filed number, and recording the verdict IS project management under this project's own philosophy, so it belongs in the SDK as a primitive with a CLI surface and a data-declared registry. The primitive set is measure (name a population), assert (bound it), gate (bundle bounds behind a lifecycle trigger), and a verdict record appended to the immutable history. Every part is data an agent can author with pm commands and jq, extended by provider plugins so a coverage percentage, a benchmark millisecond, an eval score, an RL episode reward, or a registry dist-tag are all measurable and enforceable on the same terms as an item count.

The full assurance model is declarable as workspace data through pm commands, with no repository code required to add, retune, scope, or retire a bound; The SDK exposes the primitives so the CLI, MCP, and any embedding host evaluate identical semantics, and the CLI adds no assurance logic of its own; This repository dogfoods the result: every bespoke gate script is either retired onto the primitives or carries a recorded disposition explaining why it cannot be; A gate's identity is a declared id in the registry, never a workflow step title, and the inventory is derived from the registry rather than from prose pattern-matching; Presets make the model usable on a new project in one command for at least software-delivery, research, agent-environment, and operations shapes

value.text: Measured surface at filing time (2026-08-10): 55 .mjs files under scripts/ totalling 16,184 lines; 16 files match *gate*.mjs totalling 6,500 lines; 20 scripts invoke the pm CLI as a subprocess to recompute properties over .agents/pm. scripts/release/tracker-measurement-gate.mjs alone is 929 lines and holds 30 declarations across 5 hard-coded selector sources (dependency_kind, validate_warning, graph_profile, graph_finding, health_check) — none of which can address any population the graph ANALYTICS compute, so redundancy_count, articulation_count, bridge_count and community_count are computable and unbounded. A prototype adding a sixth source was written and reverted during this session precisely because the capability belongs in the SDK, not in a script: the same 80 lines of selector plumbing would have to be rewritten by every project that adopts pm.
